PJA 0.6.3 (tag v0.6.3, commit b7bba91), https://github.com/YadeWira/PJA,
from the vendor tarball pja-0.6.3-zpaqstd.tar.gz of its release (sha256
eacc0759485670e6b04a1886c0edca53f5e9139b888f416ada91e519d9971e62, as its
SHA256SUMS says; each of its 25 files also compared with the tag's: all
the same), copied unmodified, as PPA vendors it. 0.6.3 writes the same
streams as 0.6.2; it repairs a damaged JPEG without taking minutes, and
builds its C for 32-bit x86 with -march=i686.

PMPA uses it for the JPEG pictures of ID3v2 tags (album covers): pjacodec.
Compress with version 7's model, pjacodec.Decompress. MIT (LICENSE); NOTICE
has PJA's third-party notes.

Do not patch these files here: changes go to the PJA repository, and a new
release tag comes in whole, replacing this directory.
